trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the fluke center with an approximate pixel-depth of 40-50 pixels relative to the trailing edge plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (roughly 3-7 pixels in depth) distributed continuously along the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave trajectory originating from the central notch transitioning into convex, rounded distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of high-intensity (white) circular pixel groupings localized on the distal extremities of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular white scarring and potential barnacle attachment marks concentrated on the fluke tips and scattered along the trailing margins.
